title: Real Analysis
description: Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

puzzle.goal: Add a, then a·r, then a·r², and so on, stopping after the N-th power. The value of the infinite series is defined as what these partial sums approach as N grows without bound. Write that value.

puzzle.form: lim ( N , ∞ , sum ( k , 0 , N , a * r ^ k ) )
puzzle.ask: For |r| < 1 the partial sum a(1 − r^(N+1))/(1 − r) converges. Find S for a = 3 and r = @{r}.
puzzle.method: Multiply the partial sum by r and subtract it from itself to get a closed form, then let N → ∞.
